title: Introducing Edu for Countries
summary: Edu for Countries is a new OpenAI initiative helping governments use AI to modernize education systems and build future-ready workforces.
body: Edu for Countries is a new OpenAI initiative helping governments use AI to modernize education systems and build future-ready workforces.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了一项名为“Edu for Countries”的全新倡议，旨在协助各国政府利用人工智能技术彻底现代化本国的教育体系并构建面向未来的劳动力。该项目标志着大模型厂商正加速向政府及公共教育部门拓展。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI推出了面向各国政府的教育现代化计划（Edu for Countries），反映了大模型在公共教育领域的国家级宏观落地趋势。
